mechanism_narrative: A sustained 6-month increase in real GDP growth (GDPC1) above 2.5% signals accelerating economic activity, which boosts corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If GDPC1 growth above 2.5% is not followed by positive 20-day returns in at least 60% of cases, or if the Rank IC falls below 0.04 over any 3-year period.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month rise in the federal funds rate above 4.5% signals tightening monetary policy, which increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS > 4.5% does not precede negative 20-day returns in at least 65% of cases, or if the Rank IC exceeds 0.05 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month decline in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 3.5% signals labor market tightness, which increases wage pressures and inflation expectations, reducing equity valuations and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE < 3.5% does not precede negative 20-day returns in at least 70% of cases, or if the Rank IC remains above 0.06 over any 3-year period.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month decline in the industrial production index (INDPRO) below 100 signals weakening manufacturing activity, which reduces corporate earnings and drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO < 100 does not precede negative 20-day returns in at least 65% of cases, or if the Rank IC exceeds 0.05 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month rise in the housing starts index (HOUST) above 1,500 signals accelerating residential construction activity, which boosts economic growth and corporate earnings, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If HOUST > 1500 does not precede positive 60-day returns in at least 60% of cases, or if the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year period.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month decline in the consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) below 2.5% signals easing inflationary pressures, which reduces discount rates and increases equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If CPIAUCSL < 2.5% does not precede positive 20-day returns in at least 65% of cases, or if the Rank IC exceeds 0.05 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month rise in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) above 150,000 signals accelerating labor market growth, which increases corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If PAYEMS > 150000 does not precede positive 20-day returns in at least 65% of cases, or if the Rank IC falls below 0.04 over any 3-year period.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month rise in the retail sales index (RSAFS) above 700 signals accelerating consumer spending, which boosts corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If RSAFS > 700 does not precede positive 20-day returns in at least 60% of cases, or if the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year period.
